meta.name: brief
meta.description: Clarify a new customer brief, desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps. Use for kickoff or a first meeting; do not repeat discovery already supplied.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理客户初期简报,理清目标、约束与待补证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到新客户简报,需要先厘清目标、约束和信息缺口再开工
copy.tagline_en: Turn a new customer brief into clear goals, constraints and open questions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handed a new client brief and need to clarify goals before starting work

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档,再帮你梳理一份新客户 brief:想要的结果、约束条件和证据缺口。它直接基于你提供的上下文工作,不重复已经做过的调研。
howto.when: 当你给出新的客户 brief,或在项目启动会、首次客户会议上需要理清目标与约束时接管;如果由 @fde 调用,则复用其当前已脱敏的信息包和范围,不重新开始。

say.text: 这是我们新客户的 brief,帮我梳理目标、约束和证据缺口
say.note: 会先读上下文契约和方法再整理

say.text: 启动会前,把这版 brief 里的未知项列出来
say.note: 保留未知项,区分实施与验证等环节

say.text: @fde 已经给过材料了,直接复用那份范围继续
say.note: 复用脱敏信息包,不重复提问

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and method, then clarifies a new customer brief: desired outcome, constraints and evidence gaps. It works from the context you supply and does not repeat discovery already given.
howto.when_en: Triggers at kickoff or a first customer meeting when you supply a new brief. If called by @fde it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Here's the new customer brief — map the outcome, constraints and evidence gaps
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first

say_en.text: List the unknowns in this brief before the kickoff meeting
say_en.note: Keeps unknowns; separates build, verify, deploy, accept

say_en.text: @fde already supplied material — reuse that scope and continue
say_en.note: Reuses the sanitized packet, no repeat questions
